description: This file defines a PHP interface named MailProcessor within the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Mail. The interface declares two methods for processing email-related data, including retrieving replacement variables and recipients associated with specific email events. The file serves as a contract for implementing classes handling email processing logic in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MailProcessor
classes.description: An interface defining methods for processing email templates and recipients within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getReplacements
methods.description: Returns an array of replacement strings/variables for the email template, given the email name, recipient info, roles, and associated event.

methods.name: getRecipients
methods.description: Returns an array of AbstractRecipient objects representing the intended email recipients based on email name, roles, and event.
